# Northline Search

> Evidence-based SEO audits and full-service SEO: full-site crawls, Core Web Vitals, schema, content and E-E-A-T, local SEO and AI search (GEO) readiness, delivered as a prioritized fix plan.

## Services
- [Full SEO Audit](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/#services): full-site crawl, speed tests, schema, content, E-E-A-T and AI search review with PDF report, action plan and CSV issue lists.
- [Audit + Implementation](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/#packages): the audit plus hands-on fixes and a re-crawl to verify them.
- [Ongoing SEO](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/#packages): monthly crawls, Search Console monitoring, content and AI visibility work.

## Proof
- [All case studies](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/case-study/)
- [Case study: personal injury law firm](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/case-study/personal-injury-law-firm/): Florida firm; Search Console clicks 928 to 1,769 (+90.6%) in six months, average position 28 to 18.8, 100 keywords in the top 10, 61 pages cited in AI answers.
- [Case study: mental health and wellness provider](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/case-study/mental-health-wellness-provider/): indexed pages from about 20 to 146 in three months, organic traffic +29.67%, 694 keywords in the top 10.
- [Case study: Bay Property Management Group (baymgmtgroup.com)](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/case-study/property-management/): 4,758 URLs crawled; found pricing placeholders, a sitewide broken phone link, a 15.1 s mobile LCP and AI crawlers blocked at the origin.

## Free tool
- [AI Crawler Checker](https://jingeniero06-cloud.github.io/northline-search/tools/ai-crawler-checker/): checks robots.txt rules and live access for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Bingbot and others, plus llms.txt.
